en: Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a central square or park with a bust monument in the foreground, surrounded by flower beds and curved paths. Behind it stand two large neoclassical public buildings. The left one is an ornate, older structure with a clock tower and the inscription in Cyrillic on its façade. The larger right-hand building is a symmetrical three‑storey block with many windows and a sign over the entrance in Cyrillic that appears to be the name of a gymnasium or municipal institution. People, horse-drawn carts, and workers are visible in the square. Low hills rise in the background.
